title: RADHIKA VAZ - LURKING, A STANDUP COMEDY SHOW
description: Stand-up comedy about dating, marriage, the importance of friendship, and that time of life called middle age! With sold out shows in New York, Los Angeles, London, Singapore, Dubai and all major Indian cities you don’t want to miss this. Radhika Vaz is the only Indian to have won the prestigious Gotham Award in New York for her web- series ‘Shugs & Fats’. Her book ‘Unladylike, A Memoir’ is available in stores and online.
address: 1018, Opp. Wooden Street, 80 Feet Road, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

title: Mohd Suhel Live
description: Get ready for an evening of unapologetic laughs with Mohd. Suhel Live — a stand-up comedy show where Suhel dives into brutally honest takes on his life, his parents, his brother, and everything that makes family gatherings weirdly funny. From Mumbai versus Delhi banter to dark, deadpan humor and a few jokes that almost got him into trouble, Suhel brings it all with a straight face and razor-sharp timing. It’s a mix of relatable, risky, and ridiculously funny stories that make you laugh, flinch, and nod all at once. If you love sharp observational comedy, a bit of edge, and a comic who says the things everyone’s thinking but no one says out loud — this one’s for you. Book your tickets now for Mohd. Suhel Live — raw, honest, and dangerously funny.
address: 1018, Opp. Wooden Street, 80 Feet Road, 4th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034, India

title: Satyabrat Mohapatra LIVE
description: Ex engineer , ex-banker, now professional overthinker, Satyabrat Mohapatra is back with a brand-new show filled with the sharp, witty, and deeply relatable observational comedy that has made him one of Odisha`s finest talents. In this hour, Satyabrat takes those universal experiences, flips them on their head, and dissects them with a razor-sharp wit that leaves no stone—or mundane detail—unturned. From his own life growing up in Odisha to the baffling nature of the corporate world he left behind, no topic is safe from his impeccable humor. Get ready for an evening of side-splitting stories and "I-can`t-believe-he-said-that" jokes that will have you thinking, "Wait, that`s exactly what I`ve been thinking!"
